title: Q-Edge: Symmetry-Reduced Quantum Simulation of Structured Extreme Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2609.03706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-dimensional simulation of multivariate extremes is fundamentally limited by the combinatorial complexity of dependence, often more than by the scarcity of extreme observations. We show that symmetry admits a lossless orbit-space representation that preserves structured extreme dependence while replacing an exponentially large dependence space with a compact set of symmetry classes. Based on this principle, we develop Q-Edge (Quantum Extreme Dependence Engine), a symmetry-reduced quantum framework that operates directly in orbit space, enabling scalable simulation and digital twins of structured extreme systems. By transferring symmetry into the data representation rather than the quantum circuit, Q-Edge allows unconstrained quantum generative models to exploit dramatically reduced state spaces. translated_title: Q-Edge：对称性约简的结构化极端依赖量子模拟
translated_abstract: 高维多元极端事件的模拟从根本上受限于依赖关系的组合复杂性，这种限制往往甚至超过极端观测数据稀缺所带来的制约。我们证明，对称性允许一种无损的轨道空间表示，它在保持结构化极端依赖的同时，用一个紧凑的对称类集合取代了指数级庞大的依赖空间。基于这一原理，我们开发了Q-Edge（量子极端依赖引擎），这是一个直接在轨道空间中运行的对称性约简量子框架，能够实现结构化极端系统的可扩展模拟与数字孪生。通过将对称性转移到数据表示中而非量子电路中，Q-Edge使不受约束的量子生成模型能够利用大幅缩减的状态空间。对于一个30维问题，约160万个角度状态坍缩为256个轨道状态，从而显著降低了所需的量子表示规模。
tldr: Q-Edge提出了一种基于对称性的无损轨道空间表示方法，将30维问题中约160万个角度状态压缩为256个轨道状态，从而实现了结构化极端依赖系统的可扩展量子模拟与数字孪生。
en_tdlr: Q-Edge enables scalable quantum simulation and digital twins of structured extreme dependence through a lossless symmetry-reduced orbit-space representation, collapsing approximately 1.6 million angular states to 256 orbit states for a 30-dimensional problem.
